newsitem.title: USA: CNET online service signs content providers.
newsitem.headline: CNET online service signs content providers.

text.p: CNet Inc Monday said its new Internet online service, Snap! Online, has signed over 50 content providers ahead of its scheduled September launch.

The companies include names like CNN Interactive for news, CBS SportsLine, E! Online for entertainment, and Arthur Frommer's Outspoken Encyclopedia of Travel. Infoseek will provide Snap!'s Web searching capability.

"We have hand-selected a broad cross-section of leading media companies that we feel will deliver on Snap!'s promise to users to be timely, relevant and informed," Tom Melcher, general manager, said in a statement.
